summary: The player fires several wide charged arc shots while moving laterally across the lane. At 0.3s an enemy in the middle is destroyed, and at 1.9s an enemy on the upper left is disarmed with a bright ring flash, accompanied by an on-screen Fleet Channel message ('Drift Six, disarmed, not dead'). Subsequent charged releases miss or pass through empty space.

events.evidence: Wide cyan arc travels up the center lane with a laser sweep sound
Small enemy near top-center bursts with a flash and score increases from 600 to 800
Player ship moves left then right near bottom center
Player releases a bright flash and cyan arc moving up-left
Arc strikes the upper-left enemy producing a distinct metallic/ringing hit sound and white ring flash
White ring expands around upper-left enemy, its red outline disappears, and on-screen text reads 'Drift Six, disarmed, not dead'
Player slides right across the bottom of the playfield
Cyan arc fired upward on the right side with a sweep sound
Arc passes just left of the targeted enemy on the right without hitting it
Player moves back toward the center-left
Short cyan arc released upward from center-left
Arc dissipates on the left side before reaching the top cluster of enemies

readability_issues.issue: Bright white bloom around the charging player ship obscures the ship silhouette and nearby area
Sustained bright white glow on the player ship makes it hard to see exact hitbox position
